subject: a great jellyfish filling the frame, seen close and from slightly below in black water, its bell translucent and veined with fine branching channels and ringed with crowded frilled lappets, and hanging from it a dense curtain of oral arms and trailing tentacles that falls through the whole lower half of the picture, caught in that curtain and wound about by it the pale picked-clean bones of small fish and a few thin bird skulls and a scatter of bleached vertebrae, a drowned string of prayer beads tangled in the arms, the whole animal lit from below and behind by a hot saturated magenta glow, deep pink and violet shading to crimson, the water around it and the sediment drifting through it tinted that same deep magenta, the light rising through the bell so the channels and the bones read as silhouette, more jellyfish massed in the dark behind it, fine motes and sediment filling the water everywhere to the edges of the frame
